upstream: Rokehan Location Scout beta; no numbered application version exposed
geometry_origin: Native GLB saved using public export button. No upstream program or shader extracted.
method: Native exported geometry + original local depth/normal edge and halftone shader; 7.5s overhead orbit/dolly then7.5s street dolly; deterministic time, FFmpeg encode

temporal.interpretation: Measurements screen for full-frame blackout/freeze/luma jumps. No claim of perceptual absence of line shimmer, flashes or motion discomfort.

checks.sampled_encoded_picture: Inspected frames72,180,359: 3D parallax, architecture contours and credit/title visible; no unintended black viewport. Native PNG inspected separately.

limits: Not native Rokehan video export; its shader/lights/camera are not in GLB
Geometry fidelity and guessed building heights not validated against real Nantes
Local line/halftone style differs from native PNG; fine details/foliage may shimmer. Whole-motion aesthetic/comfort acceptance pending owner
People/vehicles static, no character rig test, no audio/listening or Blender import test
Service automatically enabled low-spec display. Offline frame rendering is not evidence of realtime FPS
Private model remains outside Git; do not redistribute as an asset pack

owner_acceptance.scope: 15-second silent Nantes manga test with lighter street; no publication or generalisation
